notes.title: Monthly revista #2
notes.content:
Hola, ninjas! 🥷
August was a whirlwind in Nuevo Tokyo, and we're here to give you the lowdown on all the chaos, combos, and carnage that went down.

Gamescom 2025 – Nuevo Tokyo takes over Cologne!💥 We brought Mexican Ninja to Gamescom, and wow… the Narkuzas were shaking in their boots.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/4034db8e53ad6232b20330d27491913e9e465657.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/ae6d730b986f165295370f8cb8065546e7ffbc4d.jpg"]Whether it was at the Unity Invite-Only Showcase or the Gamescom B2B Booth in the Romanian Pavilion, players got hands-on with the demo, slicing, dashing, and occasionally face-planting into chaos.

Slots were limited, but the rebels who made it got exclusive early looks and even some limited merch to prove they survived. 🛡️

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/c62f325b4ff1e34a36f7813721a6f91027cf8757.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/0143626fcd8219ab122f46a5b4b1fbfbdfcc63c3.png"]

(Enjoy the condoms Joseph, and thanks for stopping by ;))

We gave away T-shirts, stickers, periodico, condoms, and more! Deus mio!  

Don't forget to check out our awesome IG stories we made while at the event below - some may even give you a chuckle.
https://www.instagram.com/stories/highlights/18362453479156779



MIX Fall Showcase⚡

The chaos didn’t stop there - we got officially accepted into the MIX Fall Showcase! August 29th came and went where we showed of a brand spanking new gameplay trailer!! 👀
[previewyoutube="dcCKwX_c1ew;full"][/previewyoutube]
Why is this trailer not on our socials yet? Funny you ask, pendejo. We're actually making it even better by adding more varied scenes, a swanky intro and more - in the meantime, check out the version we aired at the MIX above!



Community Testing Starts Soon! 🧪

Thanks to all the ninjas who signed up for testing in July and August! Your feedback will be a godsend. If you've played our build at gamescom, we're happy to report that bugs were squashed, combos perfected, and chaos refined. 

Sign ups close on Sep 3rd, so sign up now and join the rebellion!

https://forms.office.com/e/EFS3cStLCQ

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/f5e72453e47c23e524db32245e28f9ec1dc4183f.png"]

If you signed up already, check your inbox in the coming weeks a secret ninja message may be landing there soon. 😏

Gameplay!! 🎮
We also showed off plenty of new clips (with more coming in September!), here's a couple of our favourites!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/4d7e12e84c1f3648a679ac0bb13a4affb1e3118e.gif"]Getting taken out has never been so stinky.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/f7e9f7d05369033f7655da884aacd43daec114cc.gif"]Remember, a true ninja always looks up, because somehow there's falling explosive barrels and you don't wanna get hit by that do you?



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/0a722b99da9d92ad0a251c663f7d98c044fbb222.gif"]

We also showed a few animations we made both for El Ninja and the basic enemy types - mira!



Finally, alongside Unity, we put together a short video highlighting how we used Cinemachine to create chaotic, dynamic and endlessly fun camera angles so you can slice Narkuzas in style! 

Check it out here!
https://x.com/i/status/1958559064813654511



Le memes?! 🐐

We got so busy that we didn't cook up many incredible memes this time around - but we did make a banger one that everyone seems to love.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/8df5196bfb7431bd404299c0e337e9a7af5936cc.jpg"]

We slacked on memes in August, so we’re passing the shuriken to you. Bring your best chaos to Discord.


That’s a wrap for August! The streets of Nuevo Tokyo were messy, deadly, and hilarious - and September promises even more chaos, more wackiness, and more reasons for the Narkuzas to cry in the corner. 


And remember: wishlist now or the Narkuza will bite you when you sleep. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633473/c87dd582196fae604b9e511ff39982c0550e6ada.jpg"]Stay sharp. Stay chaotic. 


See you in the streets,
Fire

notes.title: Testing Update - 1 Week Left!
notes.content:
Hola, ninjas! 🥷

Back in June, we called on rebellious spirits to help us free the streets of Nuevo Tokyo. 🌆 Now the fight is almost over - and so is your chance to join.

⏳ Testing sign-ups close September 3rd!


If you want to play Mexican Ninja early and share your feedback, sign up now:
🈸 https://forms.office.com/e/EFS3cStLCQ



For those already enlisted, keep an eye on your inbox. A ninja may be sending you a coded message soon… 👀

See you in the streets,
Fire
